description: Installs the official Waggle plugin locally for Codex from GitHub Releases.

defaultPrompt: Set up Waggle MCP from PyPI
Download Waggle MCP from Github Releases and set it up here as a plugin
interface.longDescription:
Waggle gives Codex persistent, local-first project memory—helping it retain decisions, reasoning, and relevant context across sessions.  
This skills-only plugin installs the official Waggle Codex plugin on your machine. It downloads the latest stable marketplace bundle from the official Waggle GitHub Release and runs the standard Codex installation commands. Waggle is installed locally in a supported Codex environment; this installer does not provide a hosted service.

name: waggle-installer
